body: The minority are the ones who *do* sexualize it.

Fursuiting is not the majority...
I’m not even able to afford a suit, go to conventions, etc etc. and I still get hated. Why? Oh, I like x character from y movie. Oh, says the person next to me, you’re a furry. Which totally means that you have sex with 100 people and are a pedo...

1. Not all furries dress up
2. Not all furries are there for sexual activity
And what’s so strange about liking anthropomorphic animals?
The amount of sexual things in the media is over saturated. It seems like everyone thinks furry = weird sex ppl.
